name: 編集者
text:
まさに夏本番！　といった感じですが、ノクチルの皆さんは
夏休み中にやっておきたいことはありますか？
trans:
And now summer is in full swing! Speaking of which,
what does noctchill plan on doing for the summer
holidays?

name: 透
text:
あー……
ドラマ一気見とか？
trans:
Ahhー......
Binge-watching dramas, or something?

name: 円香
text:
いただいたお仕事にしっかり取り組んで
あとは、夏バテしないように気を付けたいです
trans:
I intend to tackle all the jobs I've been given, then
take care to not get summer fatigue.

name: 小糸
text:
えっと……みんなで宿題とか、
できたらいいなって思ってます
trans:
Erm...... I think it'll be nice if we work on our
homework together.

name: 雛菜
text:
お祭りはこの前行ったので、
浴衣着て花火大会行きたいです～！
trans:
We just went to the festival the other day, so I
wanna wear a yukata and go see the fireworks～!

name: 小糸
text: じゃあ、そろそろ出よっか！
trans: Okay, we should head out!

name: 透＆円香＆雛菜
text: ういー
trans:
Gotchaー
(Hinana: Let's go～)

name: 雛菜
text: あ、なんかきたからちょっと待って～
trans: Ah, I just got a message, give me a sec～

name: 円香
text:
私も……ていうか
これうちら全員に来てる
trans:
I got it too......
Rather, we all got the message.

name: 雛菜
text: プロデューサーからだ～……──
trans: It's from Producer～......──

name: 雛菜
text:
……──
明日の撮影、天気悪そうだから別日に変更になったんだって
trans:
......──
Looks like the weather's gonna be bad so tomorrow's
filming will be postponed to another day.

name: 円香
text: 海が見えるカフェでパンケーキ食べる仕事だっけ？
trans:
Was it the job where we would be eating pancakes at
a cafe looking over the sea?

name: 雛菜
text: 雛菜、楽しみにしてたのに～
trans: Hinana was so looking forward to it～

name: 小糸
text:
明日、お天気安定しないって
天気予報でも言ってた気がする……
trans:
Apparently the weather's rather unpredicatable
tomorrow, even the forecast said so......

name: 雛菜
text:
ん～……
明日、どうしようかな～
trans:
Uhm～......
What should we do tomorrow, then～

name: 雛菜
text:
今日、ずっと晴れだったよね～
カフェの撮影、絶対できたのに～
trans:
It's been sunny the whole of today, huh～
We would definitely have been able to film at the
cafe if we did it today～

name: 小糸
text:
で、でも、来週こそ
撮影で行けるから……
trans:
B-But, they did say that we would definitely be able
to go film there next week......

name: 雛菜
text:
そうなんだけど……
雛菜、今日行きたかった～
trans:
Even so......
Hinana wanted to go today～

name: 円香
text:
雛菜、さっきから手止まってる
終わったの？　宿題
trans:
You haven't been writing for a while now, Hinana.
Finished already? Your homework.

name: 雛菜
text: うん～、だいたい～
trans: Yea～, mostly～

name: 小糸
text:
そ、そうなんだ……！
──透ちゃんは？　進んでる？
trans:
I-I see......!
──What about you, Toru-chan? How's progress?

name: 透
text:
んー
ぼちぼち
trans:
Uhmー
Bit by bit.

name: 雛菜
text: ……行きたかったな～
trans: ......I so wanted to go～

name: 小糸
text:
……そういえば、
昨日のお仕事、みんなはなんて答えた？
trans:
......Speaking of which, during yesterday's interview,
what did you guys say?

name: 円香
text: 夏休みにやっておきたいこと、ってやつ？
trans:
Is it about, what we wanted to do during the summer
holidays?

name: 透
text:
あー……
なんか、ドラマ見るとか
trans:
Ahー......
Something about watching dramas, and stuff.

name: 円香
text: それなりに無難なやつ
trans: I just gave a relatively safe answer.

name: 雛菜
text: 小糸ちゃんは？　なんて答えたの～？
trans:
What about you, Koito-chan? What was your
answer～?

name: 小糸
text: ……宿題、かな
trans: ......Doing homework, yeah.

name: 雛菜
text: へ～
trans: Huh～

name: 小糸
text: 雛菜ちゃんは？
trans: What about you, Hinana-chan?

name: 雛菜
text: 雛菜はね～……
trans: Hinana was like～......

name: 雛菜
text: ──あ、降ってきちゃった～
trans: ──Ah, and it's now raining～

name: 小糸
text: 雨、どんどん強くなってるね
trans: Looks like the rain's getting heavier and heavier, huh.

name: 円香
text:
雛菜が浴衣着たいって
出がけにごねるから
trans:
And here we are because Hinana kept going on
about wanting to wear a yukata and going out.

name: 雛菜
text: 雨は雛菜のせいじゃないでしょ～
trans: But the rain isn't Hinana's fault, right～?

name: 小糸
text:
ふ、ふたりとも……
電車の中だから──
trans:
S-Stop it you two......
We're in the train──

name: 小糸
text:
あ……
花火大会、大丈夫かな
trans:
Ah......
I wonder if this affects the fireworks festival.

name: 小糸
text: 中止になっちゃったね……
trans: Looks like they cancelled it......

name: 小糸
text:
これからどうしよっか……
せっかくだし、どこか行く？
trans:
What should we do now......
We're already out, so should we go elsewhere?

name: 雛菜
text:
じゃあ……
次の駅で降りて、雨がやんでたら考える～
trans:
Then...... Let's get off at the next station, then
decide after the rain stops～

name: 円香
text: どこ、ここ
trans: Where exactly, is this place.

name: 小糸
text: 駅の周り、何も……ないね
trans: There's...... nothing around the station.

name: 雛菜
text: でも、雨やんでるよ～
trans: But the rain's stopped～

name: 小糸
text:
そうだね
雲は出てるけど……
trans: It did. But it's now getting cloudy......

name: 円香
text: でも、またすぐ降りだしそう
trans: Looks like it'll soon rain again, though.

name: 小糸
text: ……や、やっぱり帰る？
trans: ......S-Should we just go back?

name: 円香
text:
……でも、ここで降りたからには
雛菜に考えがあるんでしょ
trans:
......But since we got off here, you must have an idea
of what you wanna do, right? Hinana.

name: 円香
text: 粘っても花火は見られないと思うけど
trans:
We wouldn't be able to see the fireworks even if
we stick around.

name: 透
text: ねー
trans: Heeyー

name: 透
text: 空
trans: The sky.

name: 透
text:
早い
めっちゃ
trans:
It's moving fast.
Super.

name: 小糸
text:
ほんとだね……
すごい速さで雲が流れてく……
trans:
You're right......
The clouds are being blown off so quickly......

name: 雛菜
text: あっ、星見えた～！
trans: Ah, I can see stars～!

name: 円香
text: どこ
trans: Where.

name: 雛菜
text: あ～、もう隠れちゃった～
trans: Ah～, the sky's now covered again～

name: 小糸
text: また、見えるかな……！
trans: Maybe, we can see it again......!

name: 円香
text: 首、痛くなってきた
trans: My neck's getting sore.

name: 小糸
text:
あ、また雨降ってきたよ……！
駅戻ろう……！
trans:
Ah, it's starting to rain again......!
Let's head back to the station......!

name: 雛菜
text:
そうだね～
じゃあ、帰ろう～
trans:
We should～
Let's go back, then～

name: 円香
text: もう気が済んだの？
trans: Had your fun?

name: 雛菜
text:
花火は見たかったけど……
夏はまだ終わらないし、また来ればいいかなって
trans:
I wanted to see the fireworks, but...... the summer's
not over yet, so we can just come again.

name: 雛菜
text: だから、今日は帰る～
trans: That's why, I'm going home for today～
